subject: english
source: CISCE Curriculum for Primary Classes I-V (2016), official

covers: Take turns listening and speaking in class talk about set topics
Reply to what others say and ask questions to clear up doubts
Answer questions about the main details of a story read aloud
Recite simple poems with actions and expression
Describe people, places and things in their own words
Express ideas and feelings clearly in complete sentences
Follow simple two-step directions, and give them
Use words and phrases picked up from talk, stories and reading
Read with help from pictures, in print or tactile form, alone and in groups
Draw or add pictures to make ideas and feelings clear
Say who is telling the story at different points in a passage
Read grade-level text fluently, pausing at the right places
Write words and sentences, starting with a capital letter and ending with a full stop
Write about familiar topics, such as 'my teacher'
Tell one or more linked events in order, using pictures and charts, and say how they felt
Take dictation of three- and four-letter words and short sentences
Use naming, action, describing and position words, with their opposites, in context
Understand one and many, and she/he; use 'a', 'an' and 'the'
Write all upper and lower case letters
Use common, proper and possessive nouns, and match singular and plural nouns with verbs
Use verbs for simple past, present and future
Use adjectives, conjunctions, determiners and prepositions; capital letters for names; commas, full stops, question and exclamation marks
Spell three- and four-letter words, and sound out words not yet taught
Put words in alphabetical order by their first letter
